brief.headline: Push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps (market headroom at volume) and 15 days faster payment to free ₹2.60 L cash, while qualifying Manjushree as second source.

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc on 28 mm caps at higher volume or relaxed spec.
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. Verdict: MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec. Push them to the lower end by consolidating volume or accepting standard tolerances.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt.

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. Our ₹63.21 L annual spend is material but we don't know their total sales. Without financial visibility, we lean on market data and competitive pressure. The plan is to qualify a strong second source fast — Manjushree is India's largest rigid-plastic converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue — so Bprex knows they must stay sharp on price and service to keep our business.

evidence.point: We spend ₹63.21 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging.
Market asking price for 28 mm caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at volume.
HDPE resin import price is 87.61 ₹/kg — a public benchmark for raw-material cost.
Paying 15 days earlier frees ₹2.60 L cash for us.
Manjushree Technopack is India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter with ₹2569.83 Cr revenue and a strong second-source fit for pharma bottles and caps.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, pharma bottles and caps capability, health score B (65/100) — top second-source candidate to qualify now.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹1010.97 Cr revenue, strong and profitable (health B, 73/100), pharma pails and containers — robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: IVL Dhunseri Petrochem Industries Private Limited
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ): manufacturer in India-East, medium confidence — potential upstream resin or preform source.

risks: Bprex is private with no public financials — we can't gauge their financial stability or how hard to push without tipping them over.
Our ₹63.21 L spend may be large for them, or it may be small; without their revenue figure we're negotiating blind on our leverage.
Market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are leads only — none are qualified, audited or priced yet, so don't threaten to switch until we RFQ and approve at least one.
If we push price to ₹0.65–0.80/pc, they may ask for a volume commitment or tighter forecast to justify the lower rate — be ready to discuss minimum order quantities.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're reviewing all our rigid-packaging suppliers this quarter and want to talk about two things: getting your caps closer to the ₹0.65–0.80/pc we're seeing in the market at volume, and moving to 15-day payment to free up ₹2.60 L cash on our side.
